item.title: Panera Bread: Mix & Match $4.99 Menu
item.description: Save roughly 40% off regular prices by choosing up to 10 half-portion soups, sandwiches, and salads from the $4.99 Mix & Match menu, plus one side per order. (Ongoing)

item.title: Shake Shack: Any Custard for $3 with Code CUSTARDTIME
item.guid: Shake Shack-Any Custard for $3 with Code CUSTARDTIME-2026-08-02
item.description: Order any custard for just $3 at the kiosk, Shake Shack app, or mobile website using promo code CUSTARDTIME, valid through August 19. (Through August 19, 2026)

item.title: Domino's: 50% Off All Menu-Priced Pizzas - Last Day
item.guid: Domino's-50% Off All Menu-Priced Pizzas - Last Da-2026-08-02
item.description: Get half off every menu-priced pizza ordered online at participating U.S. locations today, August 2 — the final day of this summer deal covering specialty pies, build-your-own, and all crust types. (Through August 2, 2026)

item.title: Pizza Hut: Throwback Value Menu: $3 Personal Pan Pizza

item.title: Popeyes: $5 Faves Menu
item.description: Pick any item from the $5 Faves Menu — including three pieces of chicken, two sides, or a chicken sandwich — through the end of August. (Through August 31, 2026)

item.title: Arby's: $7.99 Meat & 3 Box

item.title: Sweetgreen: Alice Waters' Peach & Goat Cheese Salad
